column2: Stack exactly three stone blocks vertically in one column.
A solid flat platform of stone bricks, six blocks wide and four blocks deep, one block thick.
Build a small two-step quartz staircase, four blocks wide, two blocks deep and two blocks high. Use quartz blocks.
A solid blackstone wall, eight blocks wide, five blocks tall and one block thick.
Build a level rectangular oak plank deck eight blocks wide by six blocks deep and one block thick.
Build a clear glass panel four blocks wide, three blocks tall and one block thick.
Make a six-block-tall spruce plank pillar with a 2-by-2 footprint.
Make a flat five-by-five prismarine square, one block thick.
Build a solid block of mud bricks with a 4-by-3 footprint and a height of two blocks.

A 3-by-3 prismarine beacon five blocks tall, with a sea lantern at the highest point.
A 3-by-3, six-block-tall monument with a smooth stone base and a copper block at its tip.
A birch plank cabin with a flat red concrete roof, six blocks wide, four blocks tall and five blocks deep.
